description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named TopNavAdapter for rendering a list of top navigation categories in an Android TV app. It manages focusability, handles item clicks, and provides visual feedback for TV navigation.

classes.name: TopNavAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView ListAdapter for displaying a list of navigation category strings, with diff util support for efficient updates.

classes.name: TopNavAdapter.TopNavVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for individual top navigation items, manages focusability and click handling.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates item layout and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder at given position.

methods.name: TopNavVH.bind
methods.description: Binds text data to the TextView and sets click listener and focusability properties.
